about: X8: the bundled program_checks.py on checks-mill.nc with its form defaults, no machine chosen. The whole report; every row with a line jumps to it.

report.title: Program checks

rows.message: X50: read as 0.05 mm by 'Increments of 0.001 mm (IS-B)' (the assumed default), 0.005 mm by 'Increments of 0.0001 mm (IS-C)' or 50 mm by 'As written'; choose a machine
Y40.: a cut while the spindle is stopped (M5 on line 14)
G81 G98 Z-15. R2. F120.: the first cut after the tool change on line 18 (T2 M6), and no spindle start between them
T3 M6: a tool change while the cycle G81 (line 22) is in force
G0 X25.: a move between M29 (line 30) and the tapping cycle
G43.4: the control refuses it while the cycle G84 is in force
G65: has to stand in a block of its own; the block writes G0 in front of it or another G code
DO1: no END1 follows in the program
GOTO 900: no block N900 in this program
S1000 S1200 M3: 2 S words in one block
X123456.789: 9 digits once it is converted to increments; the control takes at most 8
(STEP OVER 50% OF THE CUTTER): a % inside a comment ends the program when it is read in from tape or a serial line
(RETRACT, THE COMMENT IS NOT CLOSED: the comment is opened with ( and not closed with ) on its line
#2=[#1+1: a [ is opened and not closed on its line
g0, x0., y0.: written in lower case; this control reads its addresses in upper case
–: – (en dash) is not an ASCII character, outside a comment
G0 X0. Y0.: after the program end M30 on line 57; it never runs

report.message: 19 findings in 18 checks. No machine chosen: where the presets read a number differently, the finding lists every reading.
